summary: Completed testing of HR Portal compensation notes and salary other income notes features. All 13 backend tests passed (1 skipped due to no pending approvals). All frontend features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. Test data created during backend tests was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compensation notes and salary other income notes features fully tested. Weekend Approvals page has Comp edit button for approved entries. Salary Overview has Notes... input below Other Income amount field.

weekend_approvals_approve_with_compensat.details: Approve dialog shows 'Mark as Compensation' checkbox. When checked, compensation notes textarea appears. Both fields are saved correctly via PUT /api/weekend-approvals/{id}/approve endpoint.

weekend_approvals_history_compensation_b.details: History tab shows compensation badge with notes for approved entries. Badge displays 'Compensation - {notes}' in amber/yellow background.

weekend_approvals_comp_edit_button.details: 'Comp' edit button appears on approved entries in history tab. Button has data-testid='edit-comp-{id}'.

weekend_approvals_edit_compensation_dial.details: Edit Compensation dialog opens with checkbox and notes field. Can update compensation flag and notes for already-approved entries.

update_compensation_endpoint.details: PUT /api/weekend-approvals/{id}/update-compensation works correctly. Updates both weekend_approvals and linked work_entries collections. Returns 400 for pending entries, 404 for non-existent entries.

salary_other_income_notes_field.details: Salary Overview page has 'Notes...' text input below the Other Income amount field for each employee. Field has data-testid='other-income-notes-{employee_id}'.

salary_adjustments_save_notes.details: PUT /api/salary/adjustments saves other_income_notes correctly. Notes are persisted and returned in GET /api/salary response.

work_entries_compensation_display.details: All Entries page shows 'COMP' badge (emerald/green color) for compensation work entries. Badge appears next to project name and hours.

employee_workentry_compensation_notes.details: Employee WorkEntry page shows compensation notes for COMP entries via title attribute on entry badges. Notes also displayed below entries when present.

weekend_approvals_page.pending_tab: Shows pending approvals with Approve/Reject buttons
weekend_approvals_page.history_tab: Shows approved/rejected entries with Comp edit button for approved entries
weekend_approvals_page.approve_dialog: Has Mark as Compensation checkbox that reveals notes textarea when checked
weekend_approvals_page.edit_comp_dialog: Opens from Comp button, shows checkbox and notes field

salary_overview_page.other_income_column: Has amount input and Notes... text input below it

all_entries_page.comp_badge: Shows COMP badge in emerald/green color for compensation entries
